title: How a Traveller Club Membership or a Corporate Programme Bears on a Hotel Reservation
content:
Holding an active traveller club membership changes what a Hotel Rate Plans reservation is charged: the club tier held on the arrival date decides the hotel discount applied to the room rate and whether late departure is guaranteed, and the rate plan's own terms decide everything else. The tier held on the arrival date is the basis; no other date governs.

**Club and corporate are exclusive.** A club discount and a corporate programme rate are mutually exclusive on one reservation: where the reservation carries a corporate programme reference the negotiated rate stands alone and no club discount is applied on top of it.

**A plan outside corporate eligibility.** A rate plan that is not eligible for a corporate rate may still be booked under a programme, but at its public price.

**What points accrue on.** Club points accrue on the room total actually paid, at the earn rate of the rate plan booked, and never on taxes, the facility fee, optional extras or the agency service fee.

**A tier that moves.** Where the member's tier changes between booking and arrival, the discount applied at booking stands and is neither topped up nor clawed back.

**A membership that is not active.** A membership that is suspended or lapsed on the arrival date carries no discount and no guaranteed late departure, whatever tier it shows.

## The combinations

| Active membership on the arrival date | Corporate programme reference on the reservation | Hotel discount applied to the room rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | no | the discount of the tier held on the arrival date |
| yes | yes | none; the negotiated rate stands alone |
| no, suspended or lapsed | no | none, whatever tier the membership shows |
| no, suspended or lapsed | yes | none; the negotiated rate stands alone |

## A point of judgement

*A member reaches a higher tier a week before arrival, after booking at a lower one.* The discount applied at booking stands: it is neither topped up nor clawed back. Whether late departure is guaranteed and what discount attaches to the room rate are read from the membership standing on the arrival date, which is where this basis looks.
